scripts.dev: npm run build:assets && npm run build:backend && concurrently -k -s first "cross-env VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api npm --prefix ../frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron-forge start"
scripts.start: npm run build:assets && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-forge start
scripts.package: npm run build:assets && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-forge package
scripts.make: npm run build:assets && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-forge make
scripts.release:windows: npm run make && npm run verify:release
scripts.lint: node --check src/main.cjs && node --check src/preload.cjs && node --check scripts/build-backend.cjs && node --check scripts/generate-icons.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-release.cjs && node --check forge.config.cjs
